newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NatMut's MD says unworried about earnings.
newsitem.headline: NatMut's MD says unworried about earnings.

text.p: National Mutual Holdings Ltd managing director Geoff Tomlinson said on Wednesday he was not worried about the earnings performance of the insurance group ahead of its half year results due out later this month.

Asked how the group was travelling in terms of earnings, Tomlinson said: "We will be announcing a half year result on May 27 - so it is inappropriate for me to say anything at this stage but I'm not crying at this stage."
Tomlinson was speaking to reporters after an address to a luncheon hosted by the Committee for the Economic Development of Australia (CEDA).
Tomlinson said the half year earnings announcement was subject to board approval and would likely be made on the afternoon of May 27.
At 2.45 p.m (0445 GMT), National Mutual shares were three cents weaker at A$1.92.
